elements.element: Vendor is obligated to both defend and indemnify for the covered claims.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph states that “Licensor shall defend and indemnify” for each claim category listed.

elements.element: Customer and its affiliates are protected parties under Vendor's defense and indemnity.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph expressly protects “Licensee and its affiliates.”

elements.element: Vendor's defense and indemnity applies to third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies to “any third-party claim.”

elements.element: Vendor's defense and indemnity covers claims alleging that the services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: It covers allegations that the “Licensed Technology, the Documentation or any other materials or services supplied by Licensor infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.”

elements.element: Vendor's defense and indemnity covers claims arising from Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause (ii) expressly covers “Licensor's breach of applicable law.”

elements.element: Vendor's defense and indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) covers “any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data caused by Licensor.”

elements.element: Vendor's defense and indemnity covers claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause (iv) expressly covers “Licensor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.”

elements.element: The indemnified party must provide notice of an indemnified claim.
elements.evidence: The procedure requires “prompt written notice of the claim.”

elements.element: The indemnifying party has control of the defense.
elements.evidence: The added procedure states that “the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense.”

elements.element: The indemnified party must provide reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The added procedure requires the indemnified party to “provide reasonable cooperation.”

elements.element: Customer's indemnity covers claims arising from Customer-provided content or data.
elements.evidence: Revised Article XII includes “content or data provided by Licensee for use with the Licensed Technology.”

elements.element: Customer's indemnity covers claims arising from Customer's own breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Revised triggers include Licensee's direct business conduct in breach of applicable law and, despite the drafting error “License,” a breach of applicable law under the Agreement.

elements.element: Customer's indemnity is limited exclusively to Customer-provided content or data and Customer's own breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Article XII retains the broader statement that Licensee is “solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability” arising from exercising its rights. Trigger (ii) also reaches Licensee's business conducted “through any affiliate” in breach of law, without requiring that Licensee itself breached the law.

elements.element: Vendor provides an intellectual-property defense and indemnity for the services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: The added Licensor indemnity covers third-party claims alleging that the Licensed Technology, Documentation, materials, or services infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for modifications made by or for Licensee appears in the added indemnity.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims caused by combinations with items not supplied or approved by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No combination exclusion appears in the added indemnity.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims caused by compliance with Customer-provided specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion appears in the added indemnity.

elements.element: Vendor must have a remedy to procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected item.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no obligation to procure continued usage rights.

elements.element: Vendor must have a remedy to modify the affected item so that it becomes non-infringing.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no modification remedy.

elements.element: Vendor must have a remedy to replace the affected item with a non-infringing alternative.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no replacement remedy.

elements.element: Vendor must provide a refund remedy if the other infringement remedies are unavailable or unsuccessful.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no refund remedy.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity liability is subject to a super-cap equal to three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No 3× annual-fees super-cap is added. Instead, the final sentence makes Article XIII's one-half-of-fees liability cap inapplicable to all obligations under the Licensor indemnity paragraph.

result.reason: The Vendor indemnity substantively includes all preferred Vendor-side triggers and procedures, but the Customer-side allocation remains broader than the preferred limitation. In particular, the retained sole-responsibility language and affiliate-conduct trigger are not confined to Customer-provided content and Customer's own legal breach. The retained sole-responsibility language also conflicts with the new Vendor IP indemnity where Licensee's ordinary exercise of the licensed rights generates an infringement claim. The fallback exclusions, infringement remedies, and 3× annual-fees super-cap are absent; Vendor indemnity is instead carved out of Article XIII's cap entirely.
